title: Glaciers on Borrowed Time - Interactive Scrollytelling & 60th Anniversary Features
shortDescription: Flagship World Water Day interactive multimedia story tracking cosmic-ray neutron sensors on retreating Bolivian glaciers, alongside the 60th Anniversary FAO/IAEA feature story.
mandateChallenge: Bring high-altitude nuclear hydrology in the Andes to global public audiences on World Water Day.
executionCraft: Combined immersive full-bleed photojournalism, SDG impact badges, and interactive scrollytelling distributed across global UN country offices.
